skill_name: Rewrite the story so that it has an open ending.
workflow: Once upon a time, there lived a magical unicorn in the forest. One day, the unicorn decided to leave the forest and explore the world beyond. After a long and difficult journey, the unicorn arrived at a big city and was amazed by its grandeur. But suddenly, the unicorn remembered something and decided to take a detour to explore what lay beyond the horizon.
